questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical ability to implement governance and automation for SAP on AWS using native services with auditable trails.

## Key Concepts
- AWS Systems Manager Automation
- SAP parameter management
- S3 versioned ledger
- CloudWatch events and SNS notifications
- CloudFormation bootstrapping

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation to create an IAM role for SSM Automation
Resources:
  SAPAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: "*"
```
```yaml
# Sample Automation Document (structure only)
Resources:
  SAPParameterUpdateAutomation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::AutomationDocument
    Properties:
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "0.3"
        description: "Update SAP parameter (example)"
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateSAPParameter
            action: aws:runShellScript
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - echo Updating SAP parameter
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you enforce least privilege for the automation role?
- How would you test this workflow in a non-prod environment?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical patch management and rollback in a real SAP on AWS setup.

## Key Concepts
- AWS Systems Manager maintenance windows
- SAP SUM patching for HANA/NetWeaver
- SAPControl health validation
- EBS snapshots for rollback
- Step Functions orchestration

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPPatchingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAPPatchingRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Path: '/'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPPatchingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:SendCommand'
                  - 'ssm:DescribeInstanceStatus'
                  - 'ssm:ListCommands'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                  - 'ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                Resource: '*'
  SAPPatchingStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SAPPatchingRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |-
        {
          "Comment": "SAP patching pipeline",
          "StartAt": "OS Patch",
          "States": {
            "OS Patch": { "Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::ssm:sendCommand", "Next": "SAP Patch" },
            "SAP Patch": { "Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Next": "Health Check" },
            "Health Check": { "Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:lambda:invoke", "End": true }
          }
        }
```

## Why This Is Asked

# Minimal IAM cross-region role (illustrative)
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPDRCrossRegionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAPDRCrossRegionRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: [ec2.amazonaws.com, ssm.amazonaws.com]

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design practical backup integrity workflow with AWS services and minimal IaC.

## Key Concepts

- AWS Backup plan
- S3 object checksums
- Lambda event-driven automation
- DynamoDB manifests
- CloudWatch alerts

## Code Example

```yaml
Resources:
  SAPBackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "backup.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBackupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::sap-backups/*"

  SAPBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: "SAP-HANA-Backup-Plan"
        Rules:
          - RuleName: "DailyBackup"
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 2 * * ? *)"
            TargetBackupVault: "SAPBackups"
```

```yaml
  SAPBackupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: { Service: "lambda.amazonaws.com" }
            Action: "sts:AssumeRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPBackupLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::sap-backups/*"
```
